name: Securities Option 84
definition: Specifies the security option of a corporate event.

MaximumQuantityToInstruct.name: Maximum Quantity To Instruct
MaximumQuantityToInstruct.definition: Maximum quantity of financial instrument that may be instructed.

MinimumQuantityToInstruct.name: Minimum Quantity To Instruct
MinimumQuantityToInstruct.definition: Minimum quantity of financial instrument that may be instructed.

MinimumMultipleQuantityToInstruct.name: Minimum Multiple Quantity To Instruct
MinimumMultipleQuantityToInstruct.definition: Minimum multiple quantity of financial instrument that may be instructed.

NewBoardLotQuantity.name: New Board Lot Quantity
NewBoardLotQuantity.definition: Quantity of equity that makes up the new board lot.

NewDenominationQuantity.name: New Denomination Quantity
NewDenominationQuantity.definition: New denomination of the equity following, for example, an increase or decrease in nominal value.

FrontEndOddLotQuantity.name: Front End Odd Lot Quantity
FrontEndOddLotQuantity.definition: Specifies that if an order is prorated holders of odd lots who tender their full position will not have tendered position prorated but rather accepted in full.

BackEndOddLotQuantity.name: Back End Odd Lot Quantity
BackEndOddLotQuantity.definition: Represents the presence of a back end odd lot provision and the quantity of equity required after proration to be eligible for this privilege.
